shared_elements: standing/upright human or anthropomorphic figures in a low-relief panel
figures flanking a central vertical element
band of small repeated signs (inscription-like) along the lower edge
relief carving on a rectangular slab
justification: Both are relief panels with upright figures arranged around a central vertical axis and a horizontal band of small repeated glyph-like signs across the bottom, which is a real but fairly generic compositional correspondence. B shows a very specific scheme absent in A — winged, bearded figures with feathered wings and bucket-and-cone gestures symmetrically flanking an elaborate stylised plant with rosettes and palmettes — whereas A's eroded imagery shows blockier, non-winged figures with no comparable vegetal centrepiece or rosette ornament, and the rendering conventions (dense fine incised feather/plant detail vs. broad plain modelled forms) differ entirely.
